description: Runs a Ruby method on concrete inputs and reports branch arms that are still uncovered. An agent reads that frontier and proposes the next inputs. Branchout does not collect or solve symbolic path constraints.

author: meganemura
description: holdfast turns each suspicion an agent writes about a Rails app (a bug, a race, an effect on another area) into a spec built with the app's factories, runs it on base and head, and answers confirmed, refuted, or could_not_run.
